decisions.reason: Chart-based web-map visualization still fits the firm's core geospatial analytics offer, but the lack of recent visibility suggests some risk of being folded into broader platform functionality rather than actively sold alone.
After several years without visible promotion, the niche hierarchical-search add-on is more likely to be retired or absorbed into standard project work than maintained as a standalone product.

The mobile layer-control component addresses a real usability need, but as a narrow UI feature with no recent market presence it is plausible to discontinue it as a separate offering and reallocate effort to newer mobile development.
Mobile field data capture remains a strong and practical fit with enterprise and public-sector GIS workflows, so it is worth keeping despite the lower recent visibility.

Search remains a central function in web-map applications, and this extension is still close enough to the established stack to keep, though there is a meaningful chance it could later be consolidated into the core platform.
